prompt: A game costs \$2 to play. A player wins \$10 with probability 0.15, wins \$5 with probability 0.1, and otherwise wins nothing. Determine whether the game is fair.
markscheme:
$E(\text{winnings})=10(0.15)+5(0.1)=2$ **(M1)(A1)**

Expected gain $=2-2=0$, so the game is fair **(R1)**

prompt: For the score on a fair six-sided die, $E(X)=3.5$. Explain what this means, given that 3.5 can never be rolled.
markscheme: It is the long-run mean: over many rolls the average score approaches 3.5 **(R1)**
